FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains beginning sounds with real recorded audio and generous feedback. A miss is met with a hint and a replay button, never a penalty — the habit being built is listening again, not being right first time. The sounds are played as pure sounds (sss, not “suh”), which is exactly how reading research says to teach them.

Prefer paper? The Sound Detective worksheet brings the same activity to the kitchen table with a parent-read sound script and an answer line — printing a worksheet never marks a class complete.
